title: RicursiveAI Launches 65B Ripple Model With New Coding Benchmarks for U.S. Open-Weight AI
summary:
A new open-weight large language model developed by RicursiveAI is targeting the top performance ranking for U.S.-based AI in agentic coding tasks. The company says the Ripple-65B Preview, which has 65B parameters and was pretrained from scratch, exceeds the capabilities of models with far higher parameter counts, including Nemotron 3 Ultra-550B and Inkling-975B.

The model was developed with a $32M compute budget, which RicursiveAI says enabled a 16x increase in compute efficiency. While some researchers credited the release as a successful effort by a small, focused U.S. team, others have questioned the company's benchmarks, arguing that the model's performance is lower than that of the 284B parameter V4 Flash.
